parts.html: The K-13 standard model is a contemporary beige minimalist kitchen that combines clean geometry, a soft color palette, and a functional use of space. The pale solid-color finish keeps the interior visually airy, while the island adds character to the kitchen and extra comfort in everyday use.

The beige tone creates a calm, cozy atmosphere, allowing the kitchen to blend naturally into modern apartments, condos, and private homes. This palette pairs well with natural wood, light stone, decorative plaster, and neutral finishing materials.

The defining feature of the K-13 model is the combination of a straight layout with a functional kitchen island. The main run of cabinets brings together the work surface, built-in appliances, and storage along one wall, while the island completes the composition, creating a separate zone for both food prep and socializing.

The upper fronts are made of acrylic-faced MDF board and the lower fronts of HPL-faced MDF board. This combination of materials gives the kitchen a contemporary look and makes it practical for everyday use. The solid-color finish unites all elements into a cohesive minimalist composition.

The compact laminate countertop emphasizes the kitchen’s contemporary character and provides a convenient work surface. The carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard. FREE FOLD Hafele lift-up mechanisms make the upper cabinets easy to open, while Muller Profi Line soft-close hinges ensure the fronts close smoothly and quietly.

Muller Box Profi Line drawers round out the kitchen’s functional hardware and make storage more convenient. The kitchen is designed for built-in appliances. This model does not include a cargo pull-out; cabinet handles are included.
Upper cabinet fronts: Acrylic-faced MDF board
Lower cabinet fronts: HPL-faced MDF board
Drawer system: Muller Box Profi Line
DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs and makes custom kitchens for apartments, condos, and private homes in Bratislava and Vienna.
The K-13 model can be adapted to the specific dimensions of your room, its layout, the location of utility connections, and the client’s preferences for built-in appliance placement and storage.
We take a comprehensive approach to kitchen furniture: design development, selection of materials and hardware, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
At the client’s request, the kitchen can also be fitted with a sink, appliances, a range hood, and plumbing fixtures.
You can order the K-13 kitchen or get a personalized price quote from DUMSKAYA DESIGN.
